scope: Every program and library Studio's bundled tools or optional engines use, how the environment check finds it, the minimum it needs, the newest version known on the check date and how to install it, and for each host (ordinary ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, Codex, Claude Code, the Claude apps) whether it was observed there, must be checked, is installed by the user, per project, or cannot run there. The check never installs anything; versions marked known_latest are a dated snapshot and --online reads the current ones.

hosts.label: Codex (CLI, IDE or app on the user's machine)
Claude Code (CLI, IDE or desktop app on the user's machine)
Claude apps (claude.ai web, desktop chat, mobile) with code execution
hosts.detect: /mnt/user-data exists and CLAUDECODE is not set (Claude Code cloud sessions have the folder too)

host_statuses.observed: reported working on this host by the owner; the check still runs before a file is promised
host_statuses.check: may be present in this host's sandbox; only running the check shows it
host_statuses.install: the user's own machine; install it when the check reports it missing
host_statuses.per_project: installed into a project folder with npm install, needs network
host_statuses.not_supported: this host cannot run it; Studio delivers the capability card's alternative

install.linux: sudo apt install libcairo2, then python3 -m pip install --user cairosvg
install.macos: brew install cairo, then python3 -m pip install --user cairosvg
install.windows: python3 -m pip install cairosvg; it needs the Cairo DLL (for example from the GTK runtime). Without it, supply the logo as a PNG
install.any: Without it, supply SVG logos as PNG

install.linux: sudo apt install ffmpeg (Debian, Ubuntu) or sudo dnf install ffmpeg (Fedora with RPM Fusion)
install.any: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html; where no system install is possible, python3 -m pip install --user imageio-ffmpeg gives the renderer a bundled ffmpeg
